title: Runs agree before any query
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, let $O$ and $O'$ be oracle languages, and let $c$ be a configuration. Suppose that at every time $s<t$, the run from $c$ using oracle $O$ is not in the query state. Then the configurations reached after $t$ steps using $O$ and $O'$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: For every s<t, the run from c using O is not in the query state
